brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1600x900 or higher resolution. Generate only ONE image.

Create a bold premium sports-editorial illustration for バスケまとめ. The fixed article is a PRE-GAME analysis comparing Chiba Jets' offense and San-en's defense on November 16, 2026. It is NOT a game result. Do not invent a score, an outcome, or an actual moment from that game.

Design: very dark green-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory typography and monochrome ink artwork, with an orange basketball as the only secondary color. Thick Japanese gothic type, dry ink and expressive brush marks, editorial screenprint textures, few clear elements. Inspired by the approved black/lime hand-ink sports poster already reviewed, but a different action and layout: the athlete occupies the LEFT 43%, the bold text sits on the RIGHT 53%. Subtle diagonal lime brush energy behind the athlete, clean dark area behind the text. Keep all type and the athlete's head, ball and hands inside safe margins, at least 5% from edges.

Real person, exactly ONE athlete: Matt Costello (マット・コステロ), as a recognizable hand-drawn illustration, no other people. His official Chiba Jets profile photo was checked. Capture these observed traits: very tall powerful broad-shouldered athletic build, light skin, close-cropped brown hair with slightly longer textured top and subtly receding temples, broad forehead, pale light eyes under straight brown eyebrows, a straight substantial nose, an elongated rectangular face with a strong jaw, and a dense neatly shaped full reddish-brown beard connected to the moustache. His beard is thick around the chin and shorter on the cheeks. Do not use a generic young clean-shaven player. Render his recognizable face in high-contrast black/ivory ink with deliberate illustrated hatching, never photographic texture.

Action: an imaginative basketball pivot/drive preparation, three-quarter torso twisting toward the right, bent knees and athletic momentum. His face is clearly visible in a three-quarter view, focused eyes looking toward the open court. He securely holds one orange basketball near his waist with both anatomically plausible hands, separated fingers curling naturally around the ball. No extra fingers or limbs. Show head to mid-thigh with intentional body framing below; keep elbows and hands fully visible. A simple ivory basketball jersey and shorts with dark edge panels, entirely UNBRANDED: no team logo, league logo, sponsor, name, letters, numbers, badges, or shoe marks. This is a conceptual illustration, not a recreation of any photographed play. Do not paste any official photograph.

Exact visible text, and no other lettering:
Top left, modest site label: 「バスケまとめ」
Top right, small date: 「2026.11.16」
Above main headline on the right, a clear lime badge with dark lettering: 「試合前予測」
Right side, prominent matchup line in ivory: 「千葉J × 三遠」
Below it, huge bold Japanese headline, two stacked lines:
「攻撃力か、」
「堅守か。」
Make the second line electric lime; ensure clear balanced reading and generous legibility at thumbnail size.
Bottom in an unobstructed dark footer strip, clearly legible ivory text: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and separately 「イメージ」

No player name in the image, no individual statistics, no claims about participation, no final score, no 'win' claim, no official logos or photos, no watermark, no photorealism. Preserve exact Japanese punctuation and the fullwidth parentheses in the AI label. Restrained energetic brush composition, crisp typography, no text overlapping face or hands.

SINGLE REVISION
Edit image 1, the already generated black-and-lime Japanese thumbnail. Image 2 is ONLY an official facial-appearance reference for real athlete Matt Costello; never paste this photograph into the output and never copy any logo or lettering from it.
Keep the entire design of image 1 unchanged: landscape 1672x941 composition, left-side single basketball player gripping the orange ball, hand anatomy, dark background, lime brush, typography, text placement, jersey and all colors. Keep EVERY visible text character exactly unchanged.
Make ONE targeted likeness correction to the athlete's head: more closely reflect the face in reference image 2. Shorten and neaten the beard, especially its chin projection, into the compact full beard seen in reference 2; retain connected moustache. Reduce exaggerated deep forehead wrinkles, preserve a high broad forehead, close-cropped brown hair, less spiky and flatter on top, subtle receding temples, a rectangular face, straight nose, pale eyes and straight brows. Keep the existing three-quarter pose and focused expression. Match the facial proportions from reference 2 while keeping the original bold hand-ink and crosshatch illustrated treatment of image 1, absolutely not photorealistic. Retain the visible natural hairline with no cropping of the head. Do not alter text, add stats, add a player name, add logos, or add any people.
